description: Compare mortgage loan insurance and travel insurance quotes in France with Réassurez-Moi.

interface.longDescription:
Réassurez-Moi is a French insurance broker registered with ORIAS. This plugin compares insurance quotes for two needs:

• Mortgage loan insurance (assurance emprunteur) for a home loan in France: new loan, switching insurer during the loan, or termination under the Bourquin/Lemoine laws. Share the loan amount, duration, rate and bank, plus each borrower's birthdate, gender and coverage share, and get live quotes from partner insurers (Soft'Emprunteur, SwissLife, Generali, Prévoir and others) with the monthly premium, annual rate and total cost of each offer.
• Travel insurance from 6 specialist insurers (Chapka, Heymondo, ACS, AVA, Mondial Care, Nomad): single trip, long stay, working holiday visa, Schengen visa and optional trip cancellation. Share destinations, travel dates and travelers' birthdates to compare the prices quoted live by each insurer and their key coverages.

Intended users: people living in France who want to compare loan or travel insurance before buying.

Limitations: loan insurance covers home loans in France only. No identity, contact or health information is requested: loan quotes are calculated for a standard profile (non-smoker, no medical risk), and smokers or people with a health condition can adjust their profile on reassurez-moi.fr. Nothing is purchased inside ChatGPT: loan insurance is subscribed on reassurez-moi.fr, and travel insurance directly on the insurer's website.
defaultPrompt: Compare loan insurance for my €250,000 home loan over 20 years at 3.5%.
Can I switch my mortgage insurance under the Lemoine law and save money?
Find travel insurance for two weeks in Thailand next April.

positive.description: Loan insurance quote for a new home loan, single borrower
positive.prompt: Hello, I'm looking for loan insurance (assurance emprunteur). I'm a man born on 15/03/1985. Loan of €250,000 over 240 months at a 3.5% rate, bank Crédit Agricole, signed on 01/09/2025, new loan, 100% coverage.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns live loan-insurance offers from partner insurers, sorted cheapest first, each with insurer name and logo, monthly premium, annual rate (TAEA), total cost and rate type, shown in the interactive comparison widget with a link to the results page on reassurez-moi.fr. The assistant does not ask for name, email, phone or health information.

positive.description: Switch existing loan insurance under the French Bourquin/Lemoine law
positive.prompt: I want to switch my loan insurance under the French Bourquin/Lemoine law. I'm a woman born on 22/07/1985. Remaining capital €200,000 over 200 months at 1.9%, bank BNP Paribas, loan signed on 10/03/2022, 100% coverage.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns live loan-insurance offers from partner insurers, sorted cheapest first, each with insurer name and logo, monthly premium, annual rate (TAEA), total cost and rate type, shown in the interactive comparison widget with a link to the results page on reassurez-moi.fr. The assistant does not ask for name, email, phone or health information. Offers also show an estimated saving.

positive.description: New loan with a main borrower and a co-borrower at 50% coverage each
positive.prompt: Loan insurance quote for my partner and me on a new loan, splitting coverage 50/50. Me: man born 12/05/1983, 50% coverage; my partner: woman born 30/09/1986, 50% coverage. Loan of €300,000 over 240 months at 3.4%, bank Caisse d'Epargne, signed on 01/10/2025, new loan.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns live loan-insurance offers from partner insurers, sorted cheapest first, each with insurer name and logo, monthly premium, annual rate (TAEA), total cost and rate type, shown in the interactive comparison widget with a link to the results page on reassurez-moi.fr. The assistant does not ask for name, email, phone or health information. Premiums are computed for both borrowers.

positive.description: Travel insurance for a two-week holiday in Spain, two travelers, with trip cancellation cover
positive.prompt: I need travel insurance for a holiday in Spain from April 10th to April 24th 2027, for two travelers born 10/05/1990 and 21/07/1991. The trip costs €1,200 per person and I want cancellation cover.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns several travel-insurance offers that include trip-cancellation cover, sorted cheapest first. Prices are quoted live by each insurer. Each offer shows the total price for the trip, coverage highlights (medical expenses, repatriation, baggage, cancellation), a guarantees table, contract documents and a link to subscribe on the insurer's website, shown in the interactive widget.

positive.description: Long-stay travel insurance for a working holiday visa (PVT) in Canada, single traveler
positive.prompt: I'm leaving for a one-year working holiday (PVT) in Canada from January 15th 2027 to January 14th 2028. I was born on 12/04/1999. Which travel insurance can you offer?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns long-stay travel-insurance offers suited to a working holiday visa, sorted cheapest first, each with the total price for the stay, coverage highlights, a guarantees table and a link to subscribe on the insurer's website, shown in the interactive widget.

review.commerce_description: The plugin compares insurance quotes. No purchase or payment happens inside ChatGPT: loan insurance is subscribed on reassurez-moi.fr, travel insurance on the insurer's website.

publication.release_notes: 3.0.1: adds travel insurance comparison (tarif-voyage). Loan insurance tools no longer request name, email, phone or any health information (smoker status, medical risk, risky sports, previous insurance refusal): quotes use a standard profile that users can adjust on reassurez-moi.fr. Widgets follow the ChatGPT UI guidelines (system fonts, no logo or marketing tagline). Listing text rewritten in English with a French translation, without promotional claims.

fr-FR.subtitle: Assurance prêt et voyage
fr-FR.description:
Réassurez-Moi, courtier en assurance immatriculé à l'Orias, compare des devis d'assurance pour deux besoins :

• Assurance emprunteur pour un prêt immobilier en France : nouveau prêt, changement d'assurance en cours de prêt ou résiliation loi Bourquin/Lemoine. Indiquez le montant, la durée, le taux et la banque du prêt, ainsi que la date de naissance, le genre et la quotité de chaque emprunteur, pour obtenir les tarifs en temps réel de nos assureurs partenaires (Soft'Emprunteur, SwissLife, Generali, Prévoir…) avec la mensualité, le taux annuel et le coût total de chaque offre.
• Assurance voyage de 6 assureurs spécialisés (Chapka, Heymondo, ACS, AVA, Mondial Care, Nomad) : voyage ponctuel, long séjour, PVT, visa Schengen et option annulation. Indiquez les destinations, les dates et les dates de naissance des voyageurs pour comparer les prix proposés en temps réel par chaque assureur et leurs garanties principales.

Pour qui : les personnes résidant en France qui veulent comparer une assurance de prêt ou de voyage avant de souscrire.

Limites : l'assurance emprunteur concerne uniquement les prêts immobiliers en France. Aucune donnée d'identité, de contact ni de santé n'est demandée : les tarifs emprunteur sont calculés pour un profil standard (non-fumeur, sans risque médical) ; les fumeurs ou personnes ayant une situation de santé particulière ajustent leur profil sur reassurez-moi.fr. Rien n'est acheté dans ChatGPT : l'assurance emprunteur se souscrit sur reassurez-moi.fr, l'assurance voyage directement sur le site de l'assureur.
